title: Flip Square Submatrix Vertically
summary: Given an m x n integer matrix grid, along with coordinates (x, y) for the top-left corner of a square submatrix and an integer k for its size, reverse the order of the rows within the submatrix vertically.
statement: Given an m x n integer matrix grid, along with coordinates (x, y) for the top-left corner of a square submatrix and an integer k for its size, reverse the order of the rows within the submatrix vertically. Return the modified matrix.
constraints: Copy grid, then select the k by k square whose top-left corner is (x,y).
Reverse only the order of rows inside that square while preserving values within each selected row.
hints: Copy the matrix so input remains unchanged.
Pair the top and bottom rows of the selected square.
Swap only their slices from y through y+k.
Half the row pairs suffice; a middle row remains fixed when k is odd.
editorial: Half the row pairs suffice; a middle row remains fixed when k is odd.

tests.explanation: Rows of the selected lower-left 3x3 square are reversed.
The two complete rows swap vertically.
